rules.exemptions: 2-family dwellings when the owner lives there
rules.title: Cambridge Fair Housing Ordinance: source of income protection
rules.requirement: Cambridge landlords may not discriminate against renters based on source of income, including Section 8 and public benefits. They may screen on ability to pay and care of the apartment if applied equally.
rules.key_value: source of income (incl. Section 8, public benefits) protected
rules.quoted_span: Source of Income, includes Section 8 and public benefits

notes: Secondary page; no effective date given. Cite chapter 14.04 as named on page. Nothing on rent, deposits, fees or eviction.
